senses.gloss: (Saf. of כפף; cmp. Del. Assyr. Handwört. s. v. סכף) to bend, knock down, maltreat; to discourage.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:10">B. Mets. VII, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 93b">93ᵇ</cite>) <he>סְכָפָהּ</he> Y. ed. a. Ar. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9), v. <cite ref="O00163"><he>סָגַף</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="O00887"><he>סָכוּף</he></cite>; pl. <he>סְכוּפִים</he>, <he>סְכוּפִין</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 88:1">Gen. R. s. 88</cite>, beg. <he>דווים וס׳</he>, (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 146:1">Yalk. ib. 146</cite> <he>שחופים</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 735">Yalk. Ps. 735</cite> <he>סַחופין</he>, v. <cite ref="O00461"><he>סָחַף</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="O00163"><he>סָגַף</he></cite>; v. infra.

senses.gloss: to bend (a person’s courage), to cause defeat, opp. סעד.
units: Lam. R. to II, 2 לא תסעוד ולא תַסְכִּיף (some ed. תִסְכּוֹף Kal; Ar. לא תסעדינן ולא תִסְכְּפִינָן Chald.) neither raise up nor bend down (neither assist, nor discourage us); Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵈ bot. תכסוף (corr. acc.); ib. 69ᵃ (in the third person) לא יסעוד ולא יסמוך (read: יַסְכִּיף or יִסְכּוֹף).
